walkthrough.use_case: Inspect one authorized Claude Messages request in a Python notebook and locate its SDK span and traceparent.
walkthrough.steps:
Pin Claude Cookbooks commit b2b0aa1 and open observability/opentelemetry_tracing.ipynb.
Use Python 3.11+ with a Claude API key and install the notebook's Anthropic Python SDK version 1.14.0 or later and OpenTelemetry dependencies.
Register the tracer provider before the first request; run the Messages section and inspect the SDK span and traceparent.
Only if an organization admin has configured an API-side destination, join those server spans in your observability backend. Keep content_mode at metadata_only unless your data policy permits content export.
walkthrough.availability: The notebook is public under MIT. Live API requests require credentials and billing; the Managed Agents section is optional, beta-limited and can create cloud resources.
walkthrough.limitations: The new artifact is a tutorial, not a new feature launch. OTel tracing is beta and span names/options may change. We inspected source and docs but did not run the notebook or observe a real trace.
walkthrough.evidence_label: October 14 commit, notebook, README, MIT license and beta SDK docs reviewed; no live API tracing test by AI Daily Diff.

youtube_description:
Anthropic added an OpenTelemetry tracing notebook to the MIT-licensed Claude Cookbooks repository on October 14. This developer briefing shows what the new artifact helps you inspect in Claude API requests and tool calls, and which parts need extra access.

- Pin commit b2b0aa1 and open observability/opentelemetry_tracing.ipynb. The notebook requires Python 3.11+, Claude API credentials, Anthropic Python SDK version 1.14.0 or later and OpenTelemetry packages.
- Register a tracer provider before an authorized Messages API call. Inspect the SDK span and traceparent first; the notebook also covers streaming and the tool runner.
- API-side spans are separate: an organization admin must configure an OTLP destination before your backend can join them to SDK spans. The optional Managed Agents section needs beta access and creates cloud resources.
- Anthropic labels tracing beta and warns the span schema may change. Metadata-only is the default; content tracing can expose prompts or responses. AI Daily Diff inspected the notebook and docs but did not run a Claude request or measure latency.
